rule_text.name: 702.264a
rule_text.rule: Advance is a keyword ability that represents a static ability that functions while the spell with advance is on the stack, and an activated ability. “Advance [cost]” means “You may choose to pay [cost] rather than pay this spell's mana cost. If you do, as the permanent it becomes enters the battlefield, it advances” and “[cost]: This permanent advances. Activate only as a sorcery.”

rule_text.name: 702.264b
rule_text.rule: “Advances” is a designation that has no rules meaning other than to act as a marker that other spells and abilities can identify. The number of times a permanent has advanced is not part of the permanent's copiable values.

rule_text.name: 702.264c
rule_text.rule: If a triggered ability refers to the mana that was spent to advance a permanent, it means the mana used to cast that spell if that ability was triggered by the creature advancing as a result of being cast for its advance ability, the mana used to activate its advance ability if that ability was triggered by the creature advancing as a result of its advanced activated ability resolving, and nothing if it is triggered in some other manner.

rule_text.name: 702.262a
rule_text.rule: Agonize appears on some instants and sorceries. It represents two static abilities: one that functions while the card is in a player’s graveyard and another that functions while the card is on the stack. “Agonize” means “You may cast this card from your graveyard if the resulting spell is an instant or sorcery spell by putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature you control as an additional cost to cast it” and “If this spell was cast using its agonize ability, exile this card instead of putting it anywhere else any time it would leave the stack.” Casting a spell using its agonize ability follows the rules for paying additional costs in rules 601.2b and 601.2f–h.

rule_text.name: 702.273a
rule_text.rule: Reconstruct represents three static abilities, one that functions while the card with reconstruct is in a graveyard, and two that functions while the spell with reconstruct is on the stack. “Reconstruct [cost]” means “You may cast this spell from your graveyard by paying [cost] and sacrificing a permanent rather than paying its mana cost,” “If you chose to pay this spell’s reconstruct cost, its total cost is reduced by an amount of generic mana equal to the sacrificed permanent’s mana value,” and “If the reconstruct cost was paid, exile this card instead of putting it anywhere else any time it would leave the stack.” Casting a spell using its reconstruct ability follows the rules for paying alternative costs in rules 601.2b and 601.2f–h.

It represents two abilities: a static ability that functions while the spell with showcase is on the stack and a spell ability. “Showcase [cost]” means “You may pay [cost] rather than pay this spell’s mana cost as you cast this spell” and “If this spell’s showcase cost was paid, exile this card, then create a 1/1 red Bard creature token with “This creature can't block.” Whenever that token attacks, you may copy the exiled card and cast it without paying its mana cost.” Casting a spell using its showcase ability follows the rules for paying alternative costs in rules 601.2b and 601.2f–h.

rule_text.rule: Wander appears on some permanent cards. “Wander (cost)” means “You may cast this permanent from the battlefield for (cost).” Casting a spell using its wander ability follows the rules for paying alternative costs in rules 601.2b and 601.2f–h.
